content:
Apple this week added a series of new products to its Certified Refurbished Store, including new MacBook Pro models powered by the M5 chip, Studio Display XDR, and higher-configured M5 MacBook Air models.

A reminder: Apple's Certified Refurbished Store is a great way to save money, with savings of up to 15%, and purchases are made directly through Apple's official website.

Below is Apple's brief introduction to the Refurbished Store:

  • Outstanding quality, attractive pricing
  • Undergoes a rigorous refurbishment process before sale
  • Comes with a one-year Apple limited warranty
  • Eligible for Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare product service plans can be purchased additionally
  • Engraving and gift wrapping services are not available for refurbished products

One thing to note: we continuously track every addition and removal of products from Apple's Certified Refurbished Store, and stock sells out quickly. One of the purposes of this report is to let everyone know in real time what inventory is available, so you can place your order before products sell out.

What's new in the Refurbished Store?

Newly added Mac products

Apple has expanded the Mac configuration options in the Refurbished Store. These models were already on sale earlier this year, and more stock was replenished this week.

The most eye-catching new arrival is the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 512GB of storage, priced at $1,439. Apple has discontinued this configuration, and the cheapest M5 model with 1TB of storage costs $1,999.

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air, 4TB storage, 24GB memory — Midnight: $2,969 (original price $3,499)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro, 512GB storage, 16GB memory — Space Black: $1,439
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with Nano-texture glass display, 2TB storage, 24GB memory — Space Black: $2,419 (original price $2,849)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro, 4TB storage, 24GB memory — Silver: $3,819 (original price $4,499)

Apple TV 4K

The Apple TV 4K has always been a hot item at the Certified Refurbished Store, and it's back in stock again this week.

  • Apple TV 4K 64GB (3rd generation) Wi-Fi version: $169 (original price $199)
  • Apple TV 4K 128GB (3rd generation) Wi-Fi + Ethernet version: $209 (original price $249)

Studio Display

  • Refurbished Studio Display XDR — Standard Glass — VESA Mount Adapter: $2,459 (original price $2,899)
  • Refurbished Studio Display XDR — Nano-texture Glass — VESA Mount Adapter: $2,719 (original price $3,199)
  • Refurbished Studio Display XDR — Standard Glass — Tilt and Height-Adjustable Stand: $2,799 (original price $3,299)
  • Refurbished Studio Display XDR — Nano-texture Glass — Tilt and Height-Adjustable Stand: $3,059 (original price $3,599)

More recommendations

Finally, Apple also added several new Apple Watch configurations and other products to the Refurbished Store this week:

  • Apple Watch SE 3 GPS+Cellular, 40mm, Starlight: $249 (original price $299)
  • Apple Watch SE GPS + Cellular, 44mm, Silver: $239 (original price $279)
  • Apple Watch SE 3 GPS+Cellular, 44mm, Midnight: $279 (original price $329)
  • iPhone 16 Pro 512GB — Desert Titanium (factory unlocked): $1,019 (original price $1,199)
